name: Candle Check Switch
description: Triggers when a torch is lit.

fields.name: Timer
fields.description: Initial countdown value. The countdown is decremented while the actor is in state 1.

fields.name: Timer Mode
fields.description: Enables the additional countdown check while the actor is in state 1.

fields.name: Enabled Variable
fields.description: The variable that gets enabled when the torch is lit.
